abstract: The New York Section held a joint meeting with the Society for Information Display’s (SID) Mid-Atlantic Chapter on 2 February at Columbia University. This was the latest in a series of joint meetings of the two organizations, all of which have focused on display technology. Seventy-five people attended in person, with another 98 participating via SID’s webinar facilities, which they graciously made available to us.
